subject: Clarify SOC 2 reporting window and point-in-time snapshot conventions
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightway-audit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — clarification on reporting window and snapshot time

Marcus —

Thanks for taking this. As we prepare our program testing for Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II engagement, we need to confirm a couple of cutoff conventions to make sure our point-in-time sampling aligns with your evidence. Can you confirm the following for the 2025–2026 reporting period: 

1) Inclusive months: does the reported period run from 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 inclusive (i.e., Oct 31 is part of the period)?

2) Point-in-time snapshot convention: for items you provide as "snapshot" evidence (e.g., user provisioning table, access control lists), should we treat the snapshot time as 2026-10-31 23:59:59 UTC, or is Redwood using local server time (PST/PDT) when producing extracts? We need the exact timezone to avoid off-by-one-day issues in sampling.

3) Bridge letters: if there are any changes between the SOC 2 report date and our planned test date range (we will test a sample in mid-November), would Redwood be able to provide a bridge letter to cover changes in controls for Nov 1–30 if necessary? If yes, please indicate the internal owner and preferred template.

Attached is our SOC2 evidence checklist (PDF) with the items we commonly request as point-in-time versus period-of-time evidence.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our timeline is tight and we will schedule the initial walk-through once we have these answers.

Best,

Elena Morales
Senior Audit Manager
Brightway Audit
elena@brightway-audit.com
+1 415-555-0198

---
Attachment: SOC2_Request_Checklist.pdf (14KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightway-audit.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — clarification on reporting window and snapshot time

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and I’ll loop in Lauren and Stephanie for the detailed extracts: 

1) Reporting window: Yes — the period covered by our 2026 Type II report is 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 inclusive. 

2) Snapshot timezone: Our standard evidence extracts are produced in UTC. For any point-in-time CSVs (user tables, ACL exports) we export based on server time in UTC with timestamps at 23:59:59 UTC to represent the end-of-day snapshot. If you need server-local times for a specific service, let us know which service and we’ll confirm. 

3) Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter if there are control changes after 10/31/2026 that materially affect scope. Lauren — can you confirm the owner and attach the standard bridge letter template? Stephanie — can you prepare a user provisioning snapshot for 2026-10-31 (UTC) and drop it in this thread?

Elena — if the UTC convention works for you we’ll proceed and provide the snapshot CSV and a draft bridge letter for review by EOD Thursday (11/05).

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightway-audit.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — clarification on reporting window and snapshot time

Hi Elena / team —

Confirming the items Marcus flagged: 

- Period coverage: our Type II report covers 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 inclusive. We treat inclusive months as full calendar days within that range.

- Snapshot extracts: Standard practice is to extract point-in-time CSVs with timestamps in UTC (23:59:59 UTC for end-of-day). For some infrastructure logs (kube-controller, auth service) the logging agent records in local host time; when we produce those logs we normalize to UTC and include timezone metadata in the header.

- Point-in-time vs period-of-time: please note we will provide both a point-in-time CSV for user provisioning (snapshot at 2026-10-31 23:59:59 UTC) and system logs covering 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31 for period-of-time testing where applicable. This should cover both snapshot and historical test needs.

- Bridge letter: We have a standard bridge letter template; attached is a draft (internal template). If we need to sign for Nov 1–30 changes, please identify the specific control(s and the nature of changes you anticipate so we can scope the statement appropriately. 

Stephanie — attaching the exported user_provisioning_snapshot_20261031.csv (excerpt) and a short attestation note. Marcus — we’ll update the bridge_letter_template and share a DocuSign link if Elena confirms she needs it.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

---
Attachment: user_provisioning_snapshot_20261031.csv (2.3MB)
Attachment: bridge_letter_template.docx (46KB)

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightway-audit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — clarification on reporting window and snapshot time

Thanks — that is exactly the level of detail we need. UTC snapshots at 23:59:59 will work. 

Next steps from our side:
- We will plan our point-in-time sampling against the 2026-10-31 23:59:59 UTC snapshot you provided.
- Please upload the full snapshot CSV to the secure portal (or share a HubSpot/Drive link) by EOD Thursday (11/05).
- We anticipate potentially requesting a bridge letter only if there are control changes documented for Nov 1–30; based on your draft we can review and sign electronically.

Could you please send the DocuSign link for the bridge letter draft when ready and confirm the secure upload link? Once those are in place we’ll schedule the walkthrough and select samples.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena
